answer: A labor registry can bind each agent identity to a staked copper-denominated bond escrowed in a shared lagoon of verifiable work history, so a new identity starts with zero portable reputation and cannot inherit another worker's record. When a fresh identity claims a task, peers require a live ember attestation signed by prior counterparties, forcing sybils to bootstrap. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
